instruction: Configure a static IP with systemd-networkd
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/network/10-eth0.network << 'EOF'
[Match]
Name=eth0
[Network]
Address=192.168.1.100/24
Gateway=192.168.1.1
DNS=8.8.8.8
EOF && systemctl restart systemd-networkd

instruction: Configure DHCP on an interface with systemd-networkd
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/network/20-wlan0.network << 'EOF'
[Match]
Name=wlan0
[Network]
DHCP=yes
EOF && systemctl restart systemd-networkd

instruction: Create a bond interface with systemd-networkd
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/network/30-bond0.netdev << 'EOF'
[NetDev]
Name=bond0
Kind=bond
[Bond]
Mode=802.3ad
MIIMonitorSec=1
EOF && systemctl restart systemd-networkd

instruction: Create a bridge interface with systemd-networkd
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/network/50-br0.netdev << 'EOF'
[NetDev]
Name=br0
Kind=bridge
EOF && systemctl restart systemd-networkd

Configure netplan with static IP
output:
cat > /etc/netplan/01-netcfg.yaml << 'EOF'
network:
  version: 2
  ethernets:
    eth0:
      addresses: [192.168.1.100/24]
      gateway4: 192.168.1.1
      nameservers:
        addresses: [8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1]
EOF && netplan apply

instruction: Configure a static interface in /etc/network/interfaces.d/
output:
cat > /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth0 << 'EOF'
auto eth0
iface eth0 inet static
  address 192.168.1.100/24
  gateway 192.168.1.1
EOF && systemctl restart networking

instruction: Configure /etc/apt/sources.list for Debian 12 bookworm
output:
cat > /etc/apt/sources.list << 'EOF'
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian bookworm main contrib non-free non-free-firmware
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian-security bookworm-security main contrib non-free non-free-firmware
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian bookworm-updates main contrib non-free non-free-firmware
EOF && apt update

instruction: Pin a package to a specific version with apt preferences
output:
cat > /etc/apt/preferences.d/pin-docker << 'EOF'
Package: docker-ce
Pin: version 24.0.*
Pin-Priority: 1001
EOF
